, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Ami Neta Hobo (2018) came out first despite having just confirmed Hood of the Living Dead’s earlier release date (August 30, 2005). This is a logical comparison/reversal error: 2005 is earlier than 2018, so Hood of the Living Dead should have been identified as first.
